mapper.select: SELECT P.PERM_CD, R.ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_NM, RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD, RA.SCOPE_ID FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = RA.ROLE_ID JOIN TB_PERMISSION_ROLE_MAPPING PRM ON PRM.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID JOIN TB_PERMISSION P ON P.PERM_ID = PRM.PERM_ID WHERE RA.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND RA.ENABLED = 'Y' AND P.PERM_ENABLED = 'Y'

SELECT 'ROLE_USER' AS AUTHORITY FROM DUAL UNION SELECT 'ROLE_ADMIN' AS AUTHORITY FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = RA.ROLE_ID WHERE RA.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND RA.ENABLED = 'Y' AND RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD = 'GLOBAL' AND R.ROLE_CD = 'ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN'
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_AUTH_VERSION AV USING (SELECT #{empId} AS EMP_ID FROM DUAL) SRC ON (AV.EMP_ID = SRC.EMP_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AV.AUTH_VER = NVL(AV.AUTH_VER, 0) + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMP_ID, AUTH_VER) VALUES (SRC.EMP_ID, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT RA.EMP_ID FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA WHERE RA.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND RA.ENABLED = 'Y'
